meta.name: battle-card-builder
meta.description: Research and draft a competitive battle card from public evidence — every claim labeled and sourced. Use when a rep needs a field-action card, not a research report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成带来源标注的竞争分析卡片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果销售团队需要快速获取可验证的竞争情报。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly draft competitive battle cards with sourced claims.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your sales team needs fast, verifiable competitive intelligence.

howto.what: 根据公开信息（定价页面、评论、发布说明、客户案例）自动生成竞争对战卡。每条声明都标注来源网址、日期和事实/推断/假设标签，卡片内容控制在销售代表30秒内能读完。
howto.when: 当销售代表需要一份针对特定竞争对手的现场行动卡片，而不是研究报告时触发。通常在你提供你的产品和目标竞争对手后开始。

say.text: 为我们的工作流平台 vs 竞争对手A构建一张对战卡，面向中市场运营买家。
say.note: AI会搜索公开证据并生成带来源的卡片。

say.text: 更新我们六个月前的对战卡，用最新来源重建。
say.note: AI会检查现有证据并补充新信息。

howto.what_en: Automatically generates a competitive battle card from public evidence (pricing pages, reviews, release notes, customer stories). Every claim is labeled with source URL, date, and Fact/Inference/Assumption. The card fits a rep's thirty-second read.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a sales rep needs a field-action card against a specific competitor, not a research report. Typically starts after you provide your product and the target competitor.

say_en.text: Build a battle card for our workflow platform vs Competitor A, mid-market ops buyers.
say_en.note: AI will search public evidence and generate a sourced card.

say_en.text: Rebuild our six-month-old battle card with fresh sources.
say_en.note: AI checks existing evidence and fills gaps.
